existing_foundation.need: Bias and externally computed allowed/banned-token masks
existing_foundation.already_available: F32 Add plus Select(mask,logit,-Inf), or checked Scatter updates; dynamic mask/bias can be ordinary bounded Graph input tensors. Grammar parsing, stop-word automata and tokenizer matching remain owners of those masks.

Host owner may provide bounded counts, or Scatter(kind=Add) can accumulate repeated IDs. Add/Multiply/Divide/Relu/Cast-to-Bool/Select express count/presence/sign rules; no mandatory special penalties operator. Exact history window, distinct prompt/output counting and commit/rollback state remain engine policy.

existing_foundation.need: Greedy, sampling, nucleus, min-p/typical-style filters and selected logprob
existing_foundation.already_available: Stable TopK, Reduce, Log/Exp, Scan, Gather/Scatter and Select compose finite filters. Categorical accepts log-weights directly, supports -Inf zero mass and optional normalized selected logprob; RandomBits is separately counter addressed. Existing shared distribution implements its declared temperature/top-k/top-p order; it is intentionally not a complete sampler-chain policy API.

existing_foundation.need: Raw logits, raw versus processed logprobs, Top-N and selected-ID scoring
existing_foundation.already_available: Graph publish/output/result preserve typed values/owners; LogSoftmax plus TopK or GatherElements supplies normalized probabilities/ranks as needed. Model already publishes logits and provides optional synchronous completed tensor capture. Selected-logprob is not a missing Categorical output. Model currently favors selected last rows; prompt-all-row convenience/scoring wiring is not a missing Graph capability.

existing_foundation.need: Branching from actual evaluated states and safe commit/rollback
existing_foundation.already_available: StateStore.begin/finalize and expected-base StateHead.publish, original ReadLease/COW cloning, plus Qwen sampling_fork/create_session give explicit immutable branches. Owner can choose candidates with existing TopK/Categorical; Beam search algorithm itself is not a missing bottom-layer primitive. No claim of arbitrary middle-history truncation without an actual stored boundary/rebuild.

architecture_review_item.name: Ordinary model selection assembly and precommit access boundary
architecture_review_item.status: Source-confirmed model wiring coupling, not a missing Compute primitive or newly demonstrated numerical bug.
facts: Family construction assembles batched greedy TopK, stochastic draw identities and validity outputs around shared sampling::distribution (main.cc:3051-3086).

The cached full-hit frontier assembles the same kinds of endpoints independently (main.cc:3602-3646), also calling that one shared distribution. Temperature/top-k/top-p mathematics are NOT duplicated.
CompletedEvaluationView is intentionally postcommit; it supports diagnostics/scoring but cannot be substituted for precommit selection (main.cc:1951,4670-4731).

finish_selected_evaluations already offers a prepublication Select callback, so arbitrary caller selection is not mathematically impossible. Its current arguments expose sampled IDs and full StepState rather than a narrow typed logits-selection contract; an external processor must understand Phase/run/output retention and the model has already run its fixed selection graph (main.cc:4423,4496-4512).
architecture_review_item.minimal_direction: When architecture work reaches this boundary, unify only ordinary greedy/draw/valid endpoint assembly and its explicit input/output contract around the existing shared distribution/public Graph values. Keep ownership, native execution and retirement in their current mechanisms. Do not introduce a callback framework, registry, second executor or new sampling feature for this audit.
must_preserve: One batched greedy TopK fast path rather than per-request expansion
Stochastic validity gate and exact owner draw/commit rules
Cached full-hit resampling from real retained hidden under the new request policy
Default Graph and no-capture fast path; no mandatory logprob normalization or tensor readback
architecture_review_item.non_claim: Absence of a CLI penalty/grammar flag is not a core capability gap; current fixed Model policy does not promise every reference-engine application sampler.

verification_boundary: Read-only local source comparison; no builds, native runs, GPU work, downloads, policy quality benchmark, new framework or product edits. Existing sampling tests were read, not newly executed. Mathematical expressibility does not claim every composition is qualified/performance-optimal on every backend.
